title: Emrys and the Contact
author: August Oyelaran
blurb: Wren Sterling, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
